$$
{d}_{1}(a,b)=‖a-b{‖}_{1}
$$

where for an $N$-dimensional vector $v,$

$$
‖v{‖}_{1}={\sum }_{i=1}^{N}|{v}_{i}|.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{d}_{1}(a,b) & =‖a-b{‖}_{1} \\  & ={‖[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]‖}_{1} \\  & =|1-(-1)|+|2-(-1)| \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
{d}_{p}(a,b)=‖a-b{‖}_{p}
$$

where for an $N$-dimensional vector $v,$

$$
‖v{‖}_{p}={({\sum }_{i=1}^{N}|{v}_{i}{|}^{p})}^{1/p}.

$$

$$
